news.titleEn: 10-year Treasury yield jumps back above 5% as oil gains and more Fed rate hikes expected
news.conclusionEn: The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield rose more than 13 basis points to about 5.125% as higher oil prices and hot inflation data led traders to fully price in a Fed rate hike in December.
news.conclusionZh: 美10年期国债收益率重回5%以上，市场押注12月加息
news.whyEn: The 10-year yield sets the price of mortgages, corporate debt and stock valuations worldwide; a move above 5% tightens financial conditions for everyone.
news.whyZh: 10年期美债是全球资产定价锚，破5%意味着房贷、企业融资和股市估值全面承压
news.detailEn: The 2-year yield climbed more than 15 basis points to about 4.88% and the 30-year reached roughly 5.45%. The selloff followed Tuesday's hotter-than-expected CPI and a jump in oil after President Trump said Washington doesn't need a deal with Iran. CME FedWatch shows a 100% chance of a December hike, with about a 13% chance of a half-point move, and Goldman Sachs added another quarter-point hike in March to its forecast. Rising yields have also pushed investors out of tech stocks and into defensive sectors.
news.detailZh: 2年期收益率大涨逾15个基点至约4.88%，30年期升至约5.45%。抛售源于周二超预期的CPI数据，以及特朗普称美国「不需要和伊朗达成协议」后油价走高。CME FedWatch显示12月加息概率为100%，加息50个基点的概率约13%；高盛也在预测中再加一次3月加息。收益率上行正推动资金从科技股转向防御板块。

news.titleEn: HSBC downgrades Nvidia, says stock to struggle until new CEO named
news.conclusionEn: HSBC cut Nvidia to hold from buy and slashed its price target to $170 from $365, saying the stock will struggle until a permanent successor to Jensen Huang is named; shares fell more than 4%.
news.conclusionZh: 汇丰下调英伟达至持有，目标价从365砍到170美元
news.whyEn: Nvidia is the biggest weight in the AI trade; a wave of downgrades after Huang's exit is dragging the Nasdaq and chip stocks such as AMD.
news.whyZh: 英伟达是AI行情核心，黄仁勋离任后连遭降级，拖累纳指和AMD等芯片股
news.detailEn: Analyst Frank Lee said uncertainty will persist until a permanent CEO is in place and shows execution ability; CFO Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO. HSBC also flagged tighter U.S. export rules as a real risk, with a bear case that cuts fiscal 2028 EPS by 13%. Truist, Evercore ISI, William Blair, Oppenheimer and Bernstein also lowered their ratings this week. The Nasdaq fell about 0.9% on Friday, and Nvidia's Nov. 17 earnings will be the first big test without Huang.
news.detailZh: 分析师Frank Lee认为，在正式CEO到位并证明执行力之前，不确定性将持续；目前由CFO克雷斯暂代CEO。汇丰还警告美国出口管制可能收紧，悲观情境下2028财年每股收益将下降13%。本周Truist、Evercore ISI、William Blair、Oppenheimer和伯恩斯坦也纷纷下调评级。周五纳指收跌约0.9%，11月17日的财报将是黄仁勋离任后的首次大考。

news.titleEn: Oil settles $3 higher on attacks on Saudi energy sites, Strait of Hormuz disruptions
news.conclusionEn: Brent settled up $3.06 at $95.82 a barrel and WTI rose $2.21 to $88.74 after Yemen's Houthis claimed attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure and Iran said four tankers were hit in the Strait of Hormuz.
news.conclusionZh: 胡塞武装袭击沙特能源设施，布伦特原油大涨3美元至95.82
news.whyEn: Attacks spreading to Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline threaten the main bypass route around Hormuz, raising inflation risk worldwide.
news.whyZh: 袭击波及绕开霍尔木兹的沙特东西管道，全球通胀压力再升
news.detailEn: The Houthis said they hit a pumping station on the East-West pipeline, an oil facility in Yanbu and an Aramco building in Riyadh; the Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed two drones. Crude had fallen about $1 in early Asian trading before rebounding on the attack claims. Bearish factors included rising OPEC+ output in October and higher U.S. inventories, leaving both benchmarks still down about 2.5% for the week. Ukraine also said its drones struck Russia's Baltic port of Ust-Luga.
news.detailZh: 胡塞武装称袭击了东西输油管道的一座泵站、延布的石油设施和利雅得的阿美公司大楼；沙特领导的联军称击毁两架无人机。原油在亚洲早盘曾跌约1美元，随后因袭击消息反弹。OPEC+10月产量上升、美国库存增加等利空因素仍在，两大基准油价本周累计仍下跌约2.5%。乌克兰还称其无人机击中俄罗斯波罗的海的乌斯季卢加港。

news.titleEn: Annual inflation hit 6.5% in October, over triple the Fed target
news.conclusionEn: U.S. producer prices rose 0.3% in October, slightly below the 0.4% forecast, but the annual rate climbed to 6.5%, the highest in about four years.
news.conclusionZh: 美国10月PPI环比涨0.3%，同比6.5%创约四年新高
news.whyEn: Producer prices feed into consumer prices; persistent pipeline inflation supports the case for further Fed hikes.
news.whyZh: 生产端通胀会传导到消费端，为美联储继续加息提供依据
news.detailEn: Goods prices led the increase with a 0.5% rise, while services rose 0.2% for a fifth straight monthly gain. Core PPI, excluding food and energy, rose 0.3%. Energy prices dipped 0.1% after a 10% surge in September. The Fed's benchmark rate stands at 3.75% to 4% after a September hike, and markets expect another quarter-point increase at the Dec. 8-9 meeting.
news.detailZh: 商品价格上涨0.5%，是主要推手；服务价格上涨0.2%，连续第五个月上升。剔除食品和能源的核心PPI上涨0.3%。能源价格在9月飙升10%后小幅回落0.1%。美联储9月加息后基准利率为3.75%-4%，市场预计12月8-9日会议将再加息25个基点。

news.titleEn: Demand remains strong for Anthropic IPO despite tech pullback
news.conclusionEn: Anthropic's IPO is reportedly about six times oversubscribed during its roadshow, even as investors sell tech stocks over AI spending and debt worries.
news.conclusionZh: 科技股回调之际，Anthropic IPO认购仍超额约6倍
news.whyEn: Set to be one of the largest IPOs ever, the deal is a key test of investor appetite for AI after Nvidia's leadership shock.
news.whyZh: 这将是史上最大IPO之一，是英伟达动荡后检验AI投资热情的关键
news.detailEn: Citing Bloomberg, Semafor reports the order book is about six times the shares on offer. The Nasdaq had its biggest monthly loss in over a year in October, and Nvidia's CEO resignation has added to concerns about the AI buildout. Goldman Sachs, one of the lead banks, expects Anthropic's revenue to exceed $600 billion by 2030. Per its filings, Anthropic is selling 825 million shares at $70 to $78, with Nasdaq trading under ANT expected around Nov. 19.
news.detailZh: Semafor援引彭博报道称，认购订单约为发售股数的6倍。纳指10月录得一年多来最大月跌幅，英伟达CEO辞职也加剧了市场对AI投资的担忧。主承销商之一高盛预计，Anthropic的收入到2030年将超过6000亿美元。根据招股文件，Anthropic拟以每股70-78美元发售8.25亿股，预计11月19日前后以代码ANT在纳斯达克上市。

news.titleEn: Iran's IRGC says 2 "violating" oil tankers disabled by blasts in Hormuz Strait
news.conclusionEn: Iran's Revolutionary Guard navy said two supertankers carrying over 4 million barrels of oil were disabled by explosions after using a route it calls unauthorized; the claim has not been independently verified.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗革命卫队称两艘「违规」超级油轮在霍尔木兹遇爆炸瘫痪
news.whyEn: It shows Iran is actively enforcing its blockade of the world's most important oil chokepoint, keeping supply risk high.
news.whyZh: 表明伊朗仍在强力封锁全球最关键的石油通道，供应风险居高不下
news.detailEn: The IRGC said the tankers took the southern route despite repeated warnings from its traffic control center. It warned that vessels switching off navigation systems and cooperating with the U.S. military would meet the same fate. Iran has restricted the strait since Feb. 28, blocking vessels linked to Israel and the U.S. after joint strikes on Iranian territory. The vessels were not named and the damage was not detailed.
news.detailZh: 革命卫队称，这两艘油轮无视其交通管制中心的多次警告，走了南部航线。它警告称，关闭导航系统并配合美军的船只将遭遇同样下场。伊朗自2月28日美以联合空袭其领土后限制海峡通行，封堵与以色列和美国相关的船只。声明未公布船名，也未说明受损细节。

news.titleEn: Mercedes-Benz halts new investment in German plants, considers closures
news.conclusionEn: Mercedes-Benz has suspended all further investment at its German sites and is weighing plant closures after labour-cost talks with its works council and IG Metall deadlocked.
news.conclusionZh: 奔驰暂停在德国的全部新投资，考虑关闭工厂
news.whyEn: It deepens the crisis in Germany's car industry, a pillar of Europe's largest economy, and puts pressure on wages and jobs.
news.whyZh: 德国汽车业是欧洲最大经济体的支柱，此举加深产业危机，冲击就业
news.detailEn: Mercedes says an hour of labour in German plants can cost up to five times as much as in Eastern Europe. Proposals include longer hours without extra pay and cuts to profit-sharing and holiday bonuses. Production chief Michael Schiebe warned two German plants could close if cost cuts fail. The move follows a profit warning last month and job cuts at Volkswagen, Audi and supplier Schaeffler.
news.detailZh: 奔驰称德国工厂每小时人工成本最高可达东欧的五倍。提议包括延长工时但不加薪，以及削减利润分成和假期奖金。生产主管Michael Schiebe警告，如果削减成本失败，可能关闭两家德国工厂。此前奔驰上月刚发布利润预警，大众、奥迪和供应商舍弗勒也已宣布裁员。

news.titleEn: GDP first quarterly estimate, UK: July to September 2026
news.conclusionEn: UK GDP grew 0.7% in the third quarter, up from 0.5% in Q2, and was 1.9% higher than a year earlier.
news.conclusionZh: 英国三季度GDP环比增长0.7%，高于二季度的0.5%
news.whyEn: Solid growth gives the Bank of England less reason to ease while inflation is rising globally, and supports the pound.
news.whyZh: 增长稳健削弱英国央行降息理由，对英镑形成支撑
news.detailEn: Services grew 0.9% and production 0.1%, while construction contracted 0.7%. Computer programming and consultancy, linked to AI and cloud work, was a notable driver. Real GDP per head rose 0.7% on the quarter. The figure will be revised in the next release in December.
news.detailZh: 服务业增长0.9%，工业生产增长0.1%，建筑业萎缩0.7%。与AI和云计算相关的软件编程和咨询业是重要拉动力。人均实际GDP环比增长0.7%。该数据将在12月的下一次发布中修正。

news.titleEn: US pushes for European presence at Ukraine-Russia talks, which Moscow refuses to confirm
news.conclusionEn: After meeting Putin and Zelenskyy, U.S. envoys Witkoff and Kushner said the next round of Ukraine talks will include European partners, but Moscow has not confirmed it.
news.conclusionZh: 美方称欧洲将加入下轮俄乌谈判，莫斯科未予确认
news.whyEn: A European seat at the table could reshape postwar security arrangements and sanctions, which matter for energy and defence markets.
news.whyZh: 欧洲入局将影响战后安全安排和制裁，牵动能源与军工市场
news.detailEn: Kushner said both sides agreed to widen the talks to cover postwar European security alongside territorial issues. Zelenskyy said Europe would have a "voice" rather than being sidelined as in the Abu Dhabi trilateral talks. Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov said Europeans must decide whether they want peace or war. Putin reportedly held firm on territorial demands and rejected foreign peacekeepers.
news.detailZh: 库什纳称双方同意扩大谈判，在领土问题之外讨论战后欧洲安全。泽连斯基表示欧洲将拥有「发言权」，而不像阿布扎比三方会谈那样被边缘化。克里姆林宫助理乌沙科夫称欧洲人必须决定要和平还是继续战争。据报普京在领土要求上毫不让步，并拒绝外国维和部队进驻乌克兰。

news.titleEn: Trump threatens to double tariffs on Mexico as a new migrant caravan heads north in Chiapas
news.conclusionEn: Trump threatened to immediately double tariffs on Mexico unless it stops a migrant caravan; President Sheinbaum replied that no caravan has reached the U.S. border since January 2025.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普威胁对墨西哥关税翻倍，辛鲍姆称无大篷车抵达美境
news.whyEn: Mexico is the top U.S. trading partner; doubled duties on steel, aluminium and vehicles would hit North American supply chains.
news.whyZh: 墨西哥是美国最大贸易伙伴，钢铝和汽车关税翻倍将冲击北美供应链
news.detailEn: A group of more than 1,000 migrants began walking north from Tapachula, Chiapas, this week. Sheinbaum said another caravan of 500-600 people has dwindled to fewer than 100 and ruled out using force against migrants. Mexico is negotiating to reduce Section 232 duties imposed last year, which the threat could complicate.
news.detailZh: 本周一支逾千人的移民队伍从恰帕斯州塔帕丘拉出发北上。辛鲍姆称另一支500-600人的队伍已缩减至不足100人，并排除对移民使用武力。墨西哥正就降低去年被征收的232条款关税与美方谈判，这一威胁可能让谈判更复杂。

businessTips.explanationEn: The sunk cost fallacy is continuing a project because of money or time already spent, even though those costs can't be recovered. Good decisions look only at future costs and future benefits. Managers fall into it because stopping feels like admitting a mistake. Asking "If we were starting today, would we invest in this?" cuts through it.
businessTips.explanationZh: 沉没成本谬误是指因为已经投入了钱或时间而继续做某件事，尽管这些投入已无法收回。正确的决策只看未来的成本和收益。管理者容易陷入这个误区，因为叫停像是在承认错误。问自己「如果今天从零开始，我还会投这个吗？」能帮你跳出来。
businessTips.exampleEn: A company has spent $2 million on software that still doesn't work. Instead of spending another $1 million because "we've come this far," it compares that $1 million against buying a ready-made tool and picks the cheaper path forward.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家公司已在一套软件上花了200万美元却仍不能用。与其因为「都走到这一步了」再投100万，不如把这100万和直接买现成工具比较，选未来成本更低的方案。

businessTips.explanationEn: A productized service packages freelance work into a fixed scope, fixed price and fixed timeline, like a product. Clients know exactly what they get, so selling is easier and there is less haggling. You can build templates and checklists to deliver faster, which raises your effective hourly rate. It is a good bridge between freelancing and running a scalable business.
businessTips.explanationZh: 产品化服务是把自由职业的工作打包成固定范围、固定价格、固定周期的「产品」。客户清楚知道能得到什么，成交更容易，也少了讨价还价。你可以用模板和清单加快交付，从而提高实际时薪。它是从接散活过渡到可规模化生意的好方法。
businessTips.exampleEn: Instead of quoting hourly for social media help, a freelancer sells a "30-post monthly content pack" for a set $600. Reusing design templates cuts delivery time from 20 hours to 10, effectively doubling the hourly rate.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位自由职业者不再按小时报价做社媒运营，而是推出固定600美元的「每月30篇内容包」。复用设计模板后交付时间从20小时降到10小时，实际时薪翻倍。

businessTips.explanationEn: Real yield is the return on a bond after subtracting expected inflation, roughly nominal yield minus inflation. It shows how much purchasing power you actually gain. Rising real yields make cash and bonds more attractive versus stocks, especially high-valuation growth stocks. In the U.S., the yield on inflation-protected TIPS is a common gauge.
businessTips.explanationZh: 实际收益率是债券收益率减去预期通胀后的回报，大致等于名义收益率减通胀率。它反映你真正获得了多少购买力。实际收益率上升会让现金和债券相对股票更有吸引力，尤其对高估值成长股不利。在美国，通胀保值债券TIPS的收益率是常用参考指标。
businessTips.exampleEn: If the 10-year Treasury yields 5% and expected inflation is 2.5%, the real yield is about 2.5%. When real yields jump, investors often sell tech stocks whose value depends on profits far in the future, as seen this week.
businessTips.exampleZh: 如果10年期美债收益率为5%，预期通胀为2.5%，实际收益率约为2.5%。实际收益率跳升时，投资者常会抛售依赖远期利润估值的科技股，本周的市场就是例子。
